name: Muse Number Five — Group read-only manual scenario
prohibited_actions: Invoke any write, publish, submit, or outbound-message endpoint
Use real relay credentials in this fixture

steps.action: Open the Group tab with no relay configuration.
steps.expected: Group shows a clear not-connected state.

steps.action: Inspect available controls in the not-connected state.
steps.expected: No send/post control or write action is available.

steps.action: Use only the placeholder fixture configuration in a test harness, not a real secret.
steps.expected: The endpoint remains visibly illustrative and does not accidentally connect.

steps.action: If an owner-approved controlled read-only source is later provided, configure it outside this fixture.
steps.expected: No real endpoint or credential is added to source control.

steps.action: Observe scheduled polling in that approved test environment.
steps.expected: Polling interval is 60 seconds when configured.

steps.action: Inspect rendering of received read-only fixture messages.
steps.expected: Received content can be displayed without any outbound request.

steps.action: Simulate source unavailability in the read-only test harness.
steps.expected: The UI reports disconnected/stale/error state truthfully.

steps.action: Inspect request logs or harness instrumentation.
steps.expected: Only reads occur; no send/post/write request is issued.

steps.action: Stop the scenario without composing or transmitting a message.
steps.expected: Scenario ends read-only; no message has been sent.
